message.content: {"note_claim": "The Moors colonised a small corner of Europe, implying the Umayyad/Moorish conquest was limited to part of Europe (Iberia) rather than the whole continent.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "Most of the Visigothic Kingdom was conquered by Umayyad troops from North Africa in 711 to 719, with only the northern reaches of Hispania remaining in Christian hands.", "reason": "The page confirms that the Umayyad (Moorish) conquest was confined to Iberia and parts of southern Gaul, supporting the note's characterization that Moors colonized only a corner of Europe."}

parsed.note_claim: The Moors colonised a small corner of Europe, implying the Umayyad/Moorish conquest was limited to part of Europe (Iberia) rather than the whole continent.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Most of the Visigothic Kingdom was conquered by Umayyad troops from North Africa in 711 to 719, with only the northern reaches of Hispania remaining in Christian hands.
parsed.reason: The page confirms that the Umayyad (Moorish) conquest was confined to Iberia and parts of southern Gaul, supporting the note's characterization that Moors colonized only a corner of Europe.
